model.name: Vigil role/novelty model
model.detector: YOLO11n single-class aircraft detector, trained on ref_train tiles only (val mAP50 0.981 on ref_calib)
model.embedder: facebook/dinov2-small, CLS ++ mean patch token, 768-d, L2-normalized
model.novelty_method: Fuzzy ART over PCA-256 + min-max + complement-coded embeddings (alpha=0.001, beta=1.0); vigilance rho* = 5.0th percentile of OUT-OF-FOLD max-match, parent-image 8-fold cross-fitting over the whole reference set (ref_train ∪ ref_calib)
model.calibrated_on: parent-image 8-fold cross-fitting within the reference set (43 images, 3,942 chips); no operational, held-out, or military data used
model.model_selection_note: PCA dimensionality (256) was chosen using military-vs-civil AUROC on operational batches, and the cross-fitted calibration was adopted after the control batch exposed split instability; treat those as model-selection decisions, not independent confirmation.
model.reference_definition: ref_train ∪ ref_calib -- the fit set for PCA, min-max scaling, Fuzzy ART categories, role prototypes, role-head temperature (tau), the 2-D UMAP reducer, and the kNN index (chip-level baseline distance + true embedding-space neighbors)
model.localization: Role and novelty scores are computed on ground-truth aircraft boxes (oracle localization). Detector recall/precision are scored separately against those boxes at IoU ≥ 0.5.

detector_card.name: YOLO11n single-class aircraft detector
detector_card.trained_on: ref_train tiles only (765 tiles, 3,136 ground-truth boxes), 30 epochs, imgsz 512, seed 0
detector_card.note: Detector performance is scored against ground-truth boxes at IoU >= 0.5 and reported separately from role/novelty scores, which are computed on ground-truth chips (oracle localization).

versions.note: Tirana: 6 single fighters labeled Military fighter, 1 confirm (confirm actions are recorded as agreement and do not alter the model; correct actions are recorded as disagreement and do not alter the model; bad_box actions are recorded as localization errors and do not alter the model)

batches.name: Control (same domain as reference)
batches.description: Held-out parent images from the same real RarePlanes collection metadata as the reference domain (clear skies, USA, off-nadir <=25deg, no military aircraft), never used for fitting or calibration -- formed at parent-image granularity.

drift.statistic: mean 5-NN cosine distance of whole-tile DINOv2 embeddings to reference tiles (scene level)
drift.null_method: parent-image block bootstrap over out-of-fold reference tiles (8-fold by parent image); the final truncated parent block's tiles are kept by random subsampling without replacement (rng.choice), not positional truncation; p-value indicative
